## Merge checklist

- [ ] The request, phase, scope, and excluded work are explicit.
- [ ] The complete diff contains no unrelated changes.
- [ ] Required validation applies to the current head SHA.
- [ ] Security and secret checks passed or limitations are disclosed.
- [ ] Durable documentation and ADRs reflect changed decisions.
- [ ] Acceptance tests were not weakened to accommodate production code.
- [ ] Review conversations are resolved.
- [ ] Required checks and approvals are satisfied.
- [ ] The human owner will squash merge; the authoring agent will not merge.
